_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 6 $8000-$8269: the jump table, reset initialisation, TGL running score and the object loop. The generators subtract these.

regions.name: Bank 6 entry slot $8000: the object loop, from slot 0
regions.description: `JMP $81FB`: the object loop, from slot 0 (called from the game loop at `$FF95`, the pause code `$E515`, the status close `$8776`, bank 0 and others). One of the 7 entries of bank 6's jump table; the object handlers are reached by the split dispatch at `$80DE / $815D`, not through it.

regions.name: Bank 6 entry slot $8003: an unread routine called by bank 3 `$935A` in the boss-defeat sequence
regions.description: `JMP $8BCE`: an unread routine called by bank 3 `$935A` in the boss-defeat sequence. One of the 7 entries of bank 6's jump table; the object handlers are reached by the split dispatch at `$80DE / $815D`, not through it.

regions.name: Bank 6 entry slot $8006: the cell lookup under a point
regions.description: `JMP $8435`: the cell lookup under a point (called by bank 1 `$81CA`). One of the 7 entries of bank 6's jump table; the object handlers are reached by the split dispatch at `$80DE / $815D`, not through it.

regions.name: Bank 6 entry slot $8009: the player's move with wall sliding
regions.description: `JMP $826D`: the player's move with wall sliding (called by bank 3 `$8FB9`). One of the 7 entries of bank 6's jump table; the object handlers are reached by the split dispatch at `$80DE / $815D`, not through it.

regions.name: Bank 6 entry slot $800C: the object loop starting at slot 1, no sprite set-up
regions.description: `JMP $81F5`: the object loop starting at slot 1, no sprite set-up (called by bank 2 `$896A`, the ending scene). One of the 7 entries of bank 6's jump table; the object handlers are reached by the split dispatch at `$80DE / $815D`, not through it.

regions.name: Bank 6 entry slot $800F: the reset initialisation
regions.description: `JMP $8015`: the reset initialisation (called from the reset path at `$FF47`). One of the 7 entries of bank 6's jump table; the object handlers are reached by the split dispatch at `$80DE / $815D`, not through it.

regions.name: Bank 6 entry slot $8012: the TGL running score total
regions.description: `JMP $805A`: the TGL running score total (called by bank 3 `$80D3`). One of the 7 entries of bank 6's jump table; the object handlers are reached by the split dispatch at `$80DE / $815D`, not through it.

regions.name: RESET INITIALISATION (slot `$800F`): variables and sound
regions.description: Called once from the reset path (`$FF44-$FF47`, bank 6 selected by `$D762`). `$A5`, `$20` (the PPU queue state), `$017F` (palette upload), `$7E`, `$7F`, `$06` := 0, then a far call (inline `00 FF 7F`) to bank 0 `$8000` (-> `$97A0`, the sound engine's init).

regions.name: Reset: the DMC timer
regions.description: `$4010` := `$81` (and `$05` := `$81`, the rate index the IRQ walks), `$4011` := 0, `$4012` := `$FF`, `$4013` := 1: the 17-byte silent sample at `$FFC0`. The DMC is used as a timer for the HUD split (see the DMC entry).

regions.name: Reset: clear the score
regions.description: `$0170-$0175` (the six score digits) := 0.

regions.name: Reset: clear zero page
regions.description: `$0A-$F8` := 0 (so `$2F`, `$30`, the pads, the scroll variables and everything else in that range start at 0).

regions.name: Reset: sprite allocator flag
regions.description: `$83` := 4 (bit 2, set once and never cleared; see the sprite allocator entry); RTS.

regions.name: TGL RUNNING SCORE (slot `$8012`): add the stage's points
regions.description: Called by bank 3 `$80D3` (the TGL reward screen). Six decimal digits: `$04B3-$04B8` (the running total, most significant first) += `$04B9-$04BE` (the points gained in the corridor, from `$04B9`...), digit by digit from the last with a carry chain (a digit of 10 or more has 10 subtracted and carries). A carry out of the top digit skips to `$8093` (255). RUN: 300 random digit sets: the stored digits equal the decimal sum.

regions.name: TGL score: the top digit
regions.description: `$04B3` is the top digit of the total: 0 gives a base of 0, 1 gives 100, 2 gives 200, 3 or more goes to `$8093` (255).

regions.name: TGL score: the displayed value `$15`
regions.description: `$15` := base + 10 x `$04B4` + `$04B5`, 255 on overflow, i.e. the first three digits of the total as a number up to 255. RUN: equals the digit formula for all random cases, 255 when the first three digits exceed it.

regions.name: TGL score: print the first three digits
regions.description: `$19:$18` := `$2094`; `$15` (when not zero) is printed with `$C051` (`$E1CD`, three blank-suppressed digits).

regions.name: TGL score: print the other digits
regions.description: A 4-byte queue run at PPU `$2097`: `$04B6`, `$04B7`, `$04B8` as ASCII digits and a fixed '0' (scores are kept in tens, the HUD does the same). RUN: queue bytes `04 20 97 d d d 30` for the sums tried. The last byte of the `JMP $C03F` is `$80DE`, the shared byte that the dispatch table's low half also counts as entry 0 (never read).

regions.name: Slot order for the reversed pass: 0-4, then 23 down to 5
regions.description: `00 01 02 03 04 17 16 ... 05`: indexed by the loop counter when `$36` bit 1 is set.

regions.name: Object loop, entry from slot 1 (slot `$800C`)
regions.description: X := 1, `$35` := 1 and on to `$8204`, skipping the sprite set-up and the frame parity step: the ending scene runs the objects without the player.

regions.name: THE OBJECT LOOP (slot `$8000`): set up
regions.description: `JSR $C096` (`$CDB4`, the sprite allocator's start of frame), `$35` := 0 (the loop's slot counter), `$36`++ (frame parity).

regions.name: Object loop: the order
regions.description: `$36` bit 1 clear: slots run 0, 1, 2 ... 23. Set: `$81DD[$35]` is used instead, a table that runs 0-4 and then 23 down to 5: the enemies run in reverse every second pair of frames, so the sprite allocator's overflow never hides the same ones. `$37` := the slot being run. RUN: `$36` = `$77`, `$7A` gave 0-4 then 23 to 5; `$78`, `$79` gave 0 to 23.

regions.name: Object loop: dispatch on the type
regions.description: Type 0 (empty) skips. Otherwise Y := type AND `$7F` and the handler is the split table (low bytes `$80DE`, high `$815D`, target minus 1) reached by `RTS`; `$8226` (the return address `$8227`) is pushed first so the handler's RTS comes back to the loop.

regions.name: Object loop: next slot
Object loop: finish the sprites
regions.description: `JSR $C099` (`$CE88`: hide the stale sprites).

regions.name: Object loop: has the player died?
regions.description: Slot 0 of type 4 means the player's ship has been destroyed. `$2E OR $48 OR $49` (lives, life, the life meter's shown value) non-zero: slot 0 becomes `$81` (type 1 again, initialised) and play goes on - the fatal state needs the meter to have run down to 0, not only the real life. All zero: the game-over sequence at `$8247`.

regions.name: GAME OVER
regions.description: Slot 0 := `$84`, objects 4 to 1 removed (`$CCBF`), `JSR $C0A2` (`$CD99`), sounds `$1F` and `$37`, `$A0` bit 0 cleared, then a far call (inline `00 0E 80`) to bank 0 `$800F` (-> the GAME OVER screen, CONTINUE and the restart). RUN: life and shown 0 gave type `$84`, slots 1-4 empty, `$A0` bit 0 clear; either non-zero gave `$81`. The sounds are read from the code, not run.
